content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not a medical-necessity denial, so the failed necessity appeal didn't address the actual issue. The claim was denied (not paid), so resubmission is not a prohibited CO-18 duplicate, and the correct way to overturn a bundling denial is to demonstrate the service was separately identifiable/payable using clinical documentation (quality 0.85 is solid). Attaching supporting records directly targets the CO-97 rationale and is the most effective single touch to progress payment.","action":"submit_with_records"}
